text: Take a moment to feel where your body is supported.
You don't have to change it.
Notice whose opinion you’ve been carrying.
You don’t have to change their mind to be yourself.
Someone else's opinion can matter to you.
It doesn't have to decide for you.
Feel your feet. Feel the place beneath you.
Ask yourself what would be true and kind for you to say.
Let their thoughts be theirs, for a moment.
You can be kind to someone else, and honest with yourself.
We're all figuring things out as we go.
You don't have to do this perfectly.
When you're ready, open your eyes.
